cd /testbed && rm -rf packages/compiler-sfc/dist && mkdir -p /tmp/vt && cat > packages/compiler-sfc/__tests__/tmp_nest.spec.ts <<'EOF'
import { compileStyle } from '../src'
test('x', () => {
  console.log(compileStyle({source:`.foo { background-color: red; /* c */ .bar {} @media only screen and (max-width: 800px) { background-color: green; .x{color:red} } }`,filename:'a.css',id:'data-v-test',scoped:true}).code)
})
EOF
npx vitest run packages/compiler-sfc/__tests__/tmp_nest.spec.ts packages/compiler-sfc/__tests__/compileStyle.spec.ts 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | tail -30; rm packages/compiler-sfc/__tests__/tmp_nest.spec.ts; git status --short
